transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess... things at work have just been weird lately. I buy inventory for a retail chain, and... well, I just can't shake the feeling that people there, and even some of the vendors, are tracking my buys. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor showed me the reports and said they don't prove anything, but... I don't know. It just feels like it's happening.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

Yeah... um, sometimes. I mean, just... if I'm in the stockroom alone, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I'll hear... it sounds like a man's voice, right behind me. He'll say, like, "Move faster, Scott," or he just laughs at my picks. But... yeah, when I turn around to look, nobody's there.
Do you ever hear two or more voices talking to each other about you?
No... um, I don't think so. It's just the one.
Does that voice ever give a running commentary on what you're doing, like narrating your actions as they happen?
No... not really. He just says those short things. He doesn't narrate everything I do.
Have people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No, I don't think so. People usually understand me fine.
Have you noticed yourself feeling much less motivated than usual to do everyday things?

I mean... yeah, I guess. On my off days I mostly just sit in my apartment. Just... scrolling through sneaker drops on my phone without really caring. And I kind of just dodge texts from friends about playing volleyball or going to gallery nights... it just feels like too much work to even answer them.
Are you completely certain that people at work are tracking your buys and altering the numbers to make you look bad?

I mean... I don't know about completely certain. My supervisor showed me the reports, and... he says they don't prove anything. But I just can't shake the feeling. 

It still seems like they are... like the people at work and maybe even some of the vendors are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers. Just to make me look stupid. It's... it's honestly what really made me come in here.
How long have you been hearing that man's voice?
Um... I guess... about ten months? Yeah, the voice... and feeling like everyone is messing with my stuff... it's been going on for around ten months.
Do you believe for certain that people at work are deliberately tracking your purchases and changing the numbers to make you look bad?

I mean... like I just said... I don't know about one hundred percent certain. My supervisor showed me the reports and said they don't prove anything, so... I don't know. 

But yeah. I just can't shake the feeling. It still feels like they're tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers. The guys at work, maybe even some of the vendors... just doing it to make me look stupid. That's... it's really the main reason I came in here.
Compared with before this started, have you been doing noticeably worse at work?

Yeah, I guess so. I've missed some deadlines. And... my supervisor actually gave me a formal warning because of some of the calls I made with the purchasing. Some of the vendors aren't too happy with me either. So yeah, work hasn't been great. And I haven't really been doing much else... stopped going to the gallery nights and volleyball on the weekends. Just haven't been seeing my friends much.
Have you had the feeling that thoughts are being put into your mind by someone or something else?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think so. It's just my own thoughts.
Have you been acting in ways that other people found very disorganized or bizarre?
Um... no. Not that I know of. I don't think I'm acting weird or anything. Nobody's said that.
Since this started, have these experiences been going on continuously for at least six months?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't exactly been keeping track of the time. It's been a while, I guess, but... I'm not sure if it's been six months.
Looking back, have these problems been present most of the time for at least six months?
I mean... like I just said, I really don't know. I haven't been counting the days or anything. It's just... hard to say.
About how many months ago did these problems first begin?

I guess... if I have to put a number on it... maybe a year and three months? Give or take. I just remember it was right after the company reorganized... we had this exclusive sneaker launch happening. So... yeah, around then.
